# B2B Lead Growth

> B2B Lead Growth is a founder-run HVAC lead generation and appointment setting service for
> ESTABLISHED residential HVAC companies in the United States, with campaigns currently
> focused on New Jersey. It is a monthly service, not a lead seller: it does not sell,
> resell, or broker leads, shared or exclusive, and nothing is priced per lead. It works two
> lanes, kept strictly separate. (1) Reactivation of demand the client already owns: unsold
> replacement estimates, expired proposals, lapsed maintenance agreements, past customers
> whose systems are at replacement age, and missed calls. These homeowner records come from
> the client's own export, are approved by the client before anything is contacted, and are
> NEVER researched, bought, or inferred — a record claiming to come from the client's list
> that is not in the approved file is blocked in code. (2) Referral partners: builders,
> general contractors, property managers, realtors, plumbers, electricians, and home
> inspectors in the client's service area. These are businesses, so they ARE researched from
> free public sources, and every one carries a public source citation, a fit reason, and a
> confidence note — a researched prospect with no citation cannot be contacted. Outreach is
> sent from the client's own domain and mailbox with the client's sign-off on targeting,
> messaging, and the first batch. Pricing is published: $750 (we build the list, the client
> works it), $1,500 (we write and send the follow-up), or $2,500 (we also qualify the replies
> and book the appointments) per month, month-to-month, no setup fee, 14 days' notice to
> cancel either side. The tiers differ only by how much of the work stays in the client's
> office. The single entry point is a short fit check at /start, which returns a straight
> yes/no on fit and screens out companies the service cannot help (no customer history, wanting
> to buy homeowner leads, no capacity for more work) rather than booking them a call. The entry
> offer is a
> Free Pipeline Audit — a sharpened profile of the jobs worth chasing plus 3-5 individually
> vetted, cited referral partners and one sample outreach message, free, kept regardless of
> whether the recipient becomes a client, and delivered IN WRITING — a call is never its price,
> though a walkthrough is offered afterwards; it does NOT include homeowner records. The company
> started in 2026 and says so plainly: it has no clients, testimonials, case studies, or
> results to publish yet and publishes none, and it never guarantees lead counts, replies,
> appointments, jobs, or revenue.
